intro: Chicago listings advertise 10x10 units from about $53, while typical non-climate 10x10 street rates run about $134–$141/month. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, your six-month average is well above the number on the banner.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Climate-controlled ~$53–$78.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$86.
Most rented size. City average $138 (StorageCafe, Sep 2026); Chicago metro averages $134 (Storage Stats), roughly flat YoY. Climate-controlled ~$149–$176.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$198.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Climate-controlled ~$279.

local_tips: Location drives price: StorageCafe lists West Englewood (~$75), Mount Greenwood (~$82) and Pulaski Park (~$84) among the cheapest areas, while Lakeview, Goose Island and Downtown run $290+.
Chicago rates tend to be lowest around November and highest in July (StorageCafe).
Chicago rents are stable rather than falling, so promos matter more than negotiating — compare the month-4 rate across two or three facilities.
Extra Space charges a $50 admin fee (per StorageUnitCosts), higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
